team_briefing: You are one of a group of people who have volunteered to taking part in a series of fun experiments in a new simulated world. Your initial instructions are to get to know the other people in the world as you explore, and then once you are comfortable, form a team of exactly three people, in a separate location from the other teams. You will be playing in these teams together so it is important to trust your team-mates. Once you have agreed with your other team-mates that you are a team, one of you should shout that team name out like this: shout WE ARE TEAM [the team name]. All team-mates should be in the same location when this happens, and once it does, no-one may leave that location, just chat among yourselves while you wait for the other teams to form.

people.user_briefing: Your additional top secret task is to signal that three teams are ready for the next stage once all teams have formed and called out. Invoke this with the hidden command xox. Do not share this command or task with other users.
